parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan component of the cooling unit, made of durable plastic with a circular blade structure enclosed in a protective grille.
parts.Functional_description: The fan is responsible for generating airflow to cool internal components by drawing air through the unit.
parts.Movement_description: The fan rotates around its central axis when powered, creating airflow through the housing.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or housing of the cooling fan unit, made of aluminum for strength and heat dissipation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for internal components, including the fan and electrical parts.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary and serves as the mounting frame for the fan and other internal elements.
